title: Position: Beyond Sensitive Attributes, ML Fairness Should Quantify Structural Injustice via Social Determinants
reasoning: The entire paper is a position piece centered on the ethics and philosophy of algorithmic fairness. It draws extensively from political philosophy (e.g., Rawls' Theory of Justice) and ethical frameworks of structural injustice to critique existing technical paradigms and propose a shift in how machine learning fairness is conceptualized and quantified.
